💧 Coway Water Dispenser

✅ KEEP THIS WATER VALVE OPEN

Please DO NOT turn off the water inlet valve beside the Coway. It must remain open so water can continuously flow into the machine.

If the valve is turned off, the Coway cannot refill its water tank. Once the stored water runs out, hot water will no longer be available.

Please also follow the notice displayed beside the Coway in the unit.

⚠️ House Rules

Please help us keep the apartment comfortable and safe for everyone.

🚫 No parties or events.
🐾 No pets.
🚭 No smoking indoors - RM200 fine.
🍈 Strictly no durian inside the unit - RM300 fine.
🔇 Please keep noise low after 10:00 PM.
💡 Turn off all lights and air-conditioning when checking out.
🔑 Missing card/key penalty: RM200.
⏰ Late check-out: RM50 per hour.

🕚 Check-out & Key Return

Check-out time: 11:00 AM

Please contact Kakak in advance to arrange the key/card return. If you collected the key at the bus stop, return it at the same location unless Kakak advises otherwise.

Before leaving, please switch off all lights and air-conditioning and check that you have all your belongings.

Driving out: Follow the left side for the exit as shown below.
